Latin name: Betula pendula / Betula pubescens / Betula spp.
Icelandic/Nordic relevance: Birki is documented in Icelandic flora; B. pendula and B. pubescens are central northern European species.
Evidence rating: Traditional use; In vitro / preclinical; Regulatory monograph
Primary safety caution: Avoid with birch leaf or birch pollen hypersensitivity; avoid where reduced fluid intake is recommended.
Reference anchors: Rastogi 2015; EMA Betulae folium; Flora of Iceland Betula pubescens

Icelandic/Nordic relevance: Mjadjurt is documented in Icelandic flora and grows in moist places.
Evidence rating: Traditional use; In vitro / preclinical; Regulatory monograph
Primary safety caution: Avoid with salicylate hypersensitivity; use extra caution with anticoagulants/NSAIDs and pregnancy/lactation.
Reference anchors: EMA Filipendula assessment; Olennikov 2016; Van der Auwera 2023; Flora of Iceland Filipendula ulmaria

Icelandic/Nordic relevance: Brenninetla is present in Iceland mainly near settlements; common in European herbal study.
